description: Only the direct dielectric reflection on the outer aggregate cover receives a grazing-angle shoulder. Explicit plants, trees, soil, inner forest, skylight and aerial scattering keep their previous shading.
method: Outer stand material 1.9 < id < 2.1 and horizon payload >= 0. Fresnel F=.04+.96*(1-LoH)^5. The rolloff blends in smoothly across F=.12 to F=.16. Above the upper threshold the unresolved specular factor approaches aperture*(.04+.96/21), the cosine-weighted hemispherical Schlick average, monotonically from below. The chosen angular transition and use of canopy aperture are aggregate approximations, not a full leaf orientation integral.

meadow.method: Full-size original and release material shaders compared on the aggregate draw alone; all foreground draws suppressed.

linearRidgeComponents.semantics: Mean RGB8 linear luminance decomposition in the exact same ROI before tone mapping: body, combined direct/environment specular, and air. The whole rectangular ROI includes any uncovered area.

fullFrameBacklight.geometryAndCamera: identical; native full draw of both independently recorded shaders

provenance: The paired Cycles study predates this outer-stand-only correction and measures fully covered foreground tree/grass pixels. The backlight image and film use corrected scene output. Opening, frontlit, shaded and spatial-reference views were originally captured before the correction; the spherical bounds and native spot/control replays qualify them separately.
